translations.text: And the Jebusites, the Amorites, and the Girgashites.
The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned after him.
Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Debir.
These six sons were born to David in Hebron. He reigned there for seven years and six months, and he reigned in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.
And Malchum his son, Peraiah his son, Shaazzar his son, Nehemiah his son, Shammua his son, and Nedabiah his son.
And Hodiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Jacob, Johanan, Delaiah, and Ain.
Eshton fathered Rapha, Rapha fathered Paseah, Paseah fathered Tehiah, and Tehiah fathered Jaazir. These were the sons of Pallu.
The sons of Ashimon: Amon, Dumiah, Zerah, and Shelah. These were the sons of Jehudiah, the brother of Nahum, the father of Keilah.
And their villages: Aqim, Aqin, Rimmon, Athcan, and Ashan—five towns.
The sons of Carmi: Shemaiah his son, Doeg his son, and Shimei his son.
And their fellow Levites, who were assigned to all the duties of the tabernacle of the house of the Lord.
Ramoth and its villages; Mahlam and its villages.
The father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon, and his wife’s name was Maacah.
Those who first settled in their inherited lands and in their towns were the Israelites, the priests, the Levites, and the resident foreigners.
Some of the sons of the priests prepared the aromatic spices for the censers.
And his second son, Abdon, and Zur, Kishon, Baal, Ner, and Nadab.
David built around the city, from the trench outward, and David gave assistance to the rest of the people who were in the towns.
David was staying in the tent, and the Philistine warriors were in Bethlehem.

At that very moment, the three men heard, broke through, and entered the Philistine camps. They went and drew water from the large well in Bethlehem, at the city gate. They took it, brought it, and gave it to David, but he would not drink it. He poured it out before the Lord.
Benaiah son of Jehoiada did all these things, and he had a greater reputation than the three warriors.
The sons of Shem from Azzun; Jonathan son of Shage from Mount Carmel.
Shemaiah from Gibeon was commander over the thirty, and he fought like all of them.
David and all Israel were praising the LORD with all their might, with songs of praise, harps, lyres, and cymbals.
These are the names of the sons born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, [?], Nathan, and Solomon.
For the descendants of Merari: Asahel the chief and his relatives, two hundred and twenty.
For the descendants of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief and his relatives, one hundred and twelve.
David summoned Zadok the priest, Abiathar, the Levites, Uriel, Laasa, Oiel, Asaiah, Isaiah, Uriel, and Amminadab.
The Levites carried the ark of the LORD, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD; they carried it on their shoulders.
Benaiah, the chief of the Levites, carried it every day in the shelter, because a place had been prepared for him.
Asaph was their chief, Zechariah was second, then Joel, Johael, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Asaph, Amminadab, Asaph, Nehazael, and Asaph.
Give thanks to the LORD and call on his name; make his deeds known among the nations.
Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of all who seek the LORD rejoice.
He said to them, “To you I give the land of Canaan as your allotted inheritance.”
Give praise to the LORD, families of the nations; give praise before the LORD for his glory and strength.
He left Asaph and his relatives there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to serve continually before the LORD, each on his appointed day.

They hired thirty-two thousand horsemen, along with the king of Haran, the king of Edom, the king of Aram-naharaim, the king of Nisibis, and their armies. They came and camped before Medeba. The Ammonites gathered from their towns and came to battle.
He entrusted the rest of the troops to his brother Abishai, who drew them up against the Ammonites.
David was informed, and he gathered all Israel and came against them. David drew up his forces for battle against the Edomites, and they fought against them.
David saw that the angel who was destroying the people had drawn back his hand and was no longer destroying them.
And now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed and build the house of the LORD your God, as he told you.

For the LORD your God is with you, helping you and supporting you against all those around you. He has handed over to you all the inhabitants of the land, and the land will be subdued before the LORD and before his people.
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four.
The sons of Hazael: Micah. For the sons of Micah: Shamir.
Meshalliah had seven sons: Zechariah his firstborn, Jediael the second, Zechariah the third, and Nethanel the fourth.
All these were descendants of Obed-edom. They, their sons, and their relatives were mighty men, capable of the work of the sanctuary—sixty-two descendants of Obed-edom.
For Levi: Hashabiah son of Mekuel. For Aaron: Zadok.
For Judah: Elihu, one of David’s brothers. For Issachar: Omri son of Michael.
Over the olive trees and sycamore trees in the lowland: Baal-hanan the Gederite. Over the stores of oil: Jeush.
Jonathan, David’s dear friend, was a counselor, a wise man and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

Here are the divisions of the priests and Levites. I have put them in charge of all the work of the Lord’s house, and they are with you. They have authority over all the work of Gershon the treasurer, and they carry it out skillfully—all the tasks required for the work of the Lord’s house. I have appointed officials and leaders over them to attend to and carry out all the required tasks.
A million talents of gold, from fine gold, and two million talents of silver, to cover the walls of the house.

They gave for the work of the Lord’s house five thousand talents of gold; fine tin for the pipes, two hundred thousand; twenty thousand talents of silver; seventy thousand talents of Corinthian bronze; and a hundred thousand talents of iron.

For yours, Lord, are greatness, might, praise, beauty, splendor and honor, because you rule in heaven and on earth. Yours, Lord, is the kingdom, and you rule over everything, and wisdom and might and knowledge.

I know, my God, that you examine the heart and delight in faithfulness. In the faithfulness of my heart I have praised all these things. Now I have also seen your people who are here praising you with great joy and saying:

“Lord, God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, our ancestors, keep forever all these things that you promised us. Turn our hearts away from evil so that we do not sin before you, and prepare our hearts to fear you.” I, David, answered and spoke in this way.
All the mighty warriors and all the sons of King David submitted to Solomon his son.
David son of Jesse established Solomon his son as king over all Israel.
